name: War Dogs: Ace Fighters of WWII
summary:
​Live to fly. Fly to live. Defeat or die. Dominate the skies.
​War Dogs is a World War II air combat flight simulator game featuring 24 warplanes from the five major powers of the era: the USA, Germany, the UK, Japan, and Russia. The game showcases the full, diverse range of aircraft used in the great war efforts—from dogfighters and dive-bombers to torpedo-bombers and long-range heavy bombers. It features both single-player campaigns and multiplayer arena battles across five major theaters of war, ranging from the deserts of North Africa to the shores of the Japanese islands.

​War Dogs has been built from the ground up as a flight simulator to offer the most immersive air combat experience. Unlike most WWII plane games on mobile, War Dogs offers both Arcade and Simulation-grade controls for both novice and experienced aces. Master all three controls (pitch, roll, and yaw) to execute basic and advanced air combat maneuvers such as the Barrel Roll, Pitchback, Wingover, and more.
